candidates.name: thoracic sarcoma
support_spans: a homogeneous right paratracheal mediastinal mass compressing and displacing the trachea to the left
an 11 × 8.6 × 9.5 cm lobulated solid mass arising from the right thoracic operculum/pleura
candidates.why: The patient presents with a large mediastinal mass and pleural involvement, which is consistent with thoracic sarcoma.

candidates.name: pleural lymphoma
support_spans: a nodular pleural component
mass effect on the right hilum, supra-aortic vessels, and superior vena cava
candidates.why: The patient has a pleural component to the mass and significant lymphadenopathy, which could be indicative of pleural lymphoma.

candidates.name: Ewing's sarcoma
support_spans: lytic destruction with cortical fracture of the T1 and T2 vertebrae
elevated LDH
candidates.why: The patient's presentation with lytic bone lesions and elevated LDH is consistent with Ewing's sarcoma, a malignant bone tumor.

candidates.name: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
support_spans: elevated lactic acid
elevated C-reactive protein
candidates.why: The patient's presentation with elevated lactic acid and C-reactive protein could be indicative of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, an aggressive lymphoma.

candidates.name: malignant germ cell tumor
support_spans: elevated LDH
lytic destruction with cortical fracture of the T1 and T2 vertebrae
candidates.why: A definitive diagnosis of malignant germ cell tumor would require histopathological examination of the tumor, which could be obtained through video-assisted thoracoscopic biopsy.

candidates.name: thymic carcinoma
support_spans: a homogeneous right paratracheal mediastinal mass compressing and displacing the trachea to the left
elevated calcium
candidates.why: A definitive diagnosis of thymic carcinoma would require histopathological examination of the tumor and could be supported by imaging findings such as a mediastinal mass.
